newsitem.title: GERMANY: Heidelberger has good Q1, plans listing.
newsitem.headline: Heidelberger has good Q1, plans listing.

text.p: Printing machinery maker Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG said on Thursday first quarter sales and orders were up and confirmed it would seek a German bourse listing this year.
The company said a bank consortium including Commerzbank, Dresdner Bank, Deutsche Bank and Banque Paribas would place 15 percent of its equity.
Heidelberger Druck is 57 percent owned by the Essen-based utility group RWE AG.
The company reported group net profits in the year to March 31 of 353 million marks ($193.5 million), compared to 268 million marks the year before. Sales rose to 5.1 billion marks from 4.3 billion.
"We managed to continue the successful development of last year in the first quarter," chief executive Hartmut Mehdorn said in a statement, adding he hoped to boost both earnings and sales this year.
He also said the current year would be one of consolidation, and the integration of Linotype-Hell AG -- taken over by Heidelberger last September -- was going well but not yet complete.
